services.name: Sunset Kayak + Yoga
services.desc: 2 hours About Join us for truly a one of a kind evening on the water! We'll begin by gathering at Harbor Yak before paddling together down the river to a quiet spot we like to call "Kayak Cove". The paddle is relaxed and comfortable, lasting about 20-25 minutes and giving you time to settle in and enjoy the surroundings. After arriving at our sandy beach landing, we'll get set up and situated for a 45 minute guided yoga flow. This practice is accessible, intentional and paced to allow you to experience both movement and stillness as the day fades into evening. As the sun dips below Sandbar Yoga

services.name: Beach Glass Festival | Ashtabula Harbor Captained Cruise
Lighted Boat Parade and Fireworks
services.desc: Every year during the wine and walleye festival there is a lighted boat parade before the fireworks show! The kayaks always join in, and its so much fun to participate, paddle in the parade, show off your lighted kayak and then watch an awesome firework display from the water. What to bring Participants must provide their own lights/decorations, and tape to attach to kayaks. It's recommended to bring water, a light jacket/sweater and or blanket and bug spray. More details We have customers arrive early for this event to start decorating their kayak. At dark we follow a line of boats out 2026 Wine & Walleye Lighted Boat Parade (kayaks+hydrobikes)
